summary: Static browser implementation of the management loop

rules.weekly_report: every seven days, training/work/fame goals are scored and the next week goal is generated
rules.work_resolution: commercial, audition, recording and drama require stat/fame/week gates; success chance combines skill, mood and fame
rules.chapter_loop: a chapter runs for a fixed number of days and checks work count, fans gained and best stat before rewarding or restarting the plan

web_implication: Can be served by any static file server and does not require Node, Python, or a build step.
